panels.title: Provider TTFT p95 vs NFR-P-1 (grounded < 1.5s, ungrounded < 800ms)
Faithfulness / refusal / citation trends — not a live metric

options.content:
**Honest gap, documented not faked:** faithfulness, refusal correctness, hallucinated-citation rate, retrieval hit rate, and threshold-refusal rate are all **eval-harness outputs** (§6.4), produced by the nightly/release eval run and published to `docs/evals/latest-report.md` (trend-charted there, not here).

Wiring these into a live Grafana panel would need either (a) a Pushgateway the nightly eval workflow pushes to, or (b) a Loki-scraped structured log of eval results — neither exists yet. Tracked as a real, scoped follow-up rather than faked with a metric that doesn't exist.

See: [latest eval report](../../../docs/evals/latest-report.md).
